run_collect_history: run the script to collect line counts for each git commit in a date range
run_daterange: run the daterange generator to yield dates between a start and end date
run_cloc_count: run cloc to count lines of code and output results as a YAML file
run_git_checkout_by_date: run git checkout to switch to the commit before a given date on master
run_git_clean: run git clean to remove untracked files and directories from the working tree
